name: Strategic Planning / Southeast Task Force Committee Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I
  Strategic Planning I Southeast Task Force Committee
  will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time and place,
  and will address the agenda listed below:

  CITY HALL
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Monday, November 4, 2019
  5:00 PM

  AGENDA

  1)  Public Comment
  a.  Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on items listed on the agenda.

  2)  Welcome and Introduction

  3)  Continuation of Discussion of Urban Design in the Southeast Area of
  Beverly Hills

  4)  Activity and Feedback

  5)  Adjournment
  The next meeting of the Strategic Planning/Southeast Task Force Committee is
  scheduled for December 9, 2019.

  Huma Ahmed, City Clerk

  Posted: October 17, 2019

Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable efforts to
 accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call (310) 285-1014
  (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (TrY). Providing at least forty-eight (48) hours advance notice will help to
ensure availability of services. City Hall, including the Council Chamber, is wheelchair accessible. The
  City Hall Council Chamber is also equipped with audio equipment for the hearing impaired.
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Strategic Planning/Southeast Taskforce/Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, November 4, 2019
  5:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  November 4, 2019 / 5:00pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor John A. Mirisch, Councilmember Dr. Julian Gold, City
  Treasurer Howard Fisher, City Manager George Chavez, Director
  of Community Development Susan Healy Keene, Assistant Director
  of Community Development Ryan Gohlich, Senior Planner Timmi
  Tway, Marketing and Economic Sustainability Manager Laura
  Biery, Adonis Angelo Antonio Simmons (Next Beverly Hills), John
  DeLuca (Resident), Jim Garrett (Resident), Andrea Grossman,
  Perry Cohan, Edward Brown (Resident), Linda Brown (Resident),
  Susan Mishler (Resident), Isaac Gabai (Resident), John Luca
  (Resident), Sharon Ignarro (Resident), Jim Garrett (Resident), Sy
  Schaffel, Abraham Assil
  1)  Public Comment
  1. David Gingold provided public comment.

  2) Welcome and Introduction
   Brief introduction from committee attendees
   Brief overview of the last meeting: urban design

  3) Continuation of Discussion of Urban Design in the Southeast Area of Beverly
  Hills
   Presentation by City staff
   Discussion regarding urban design focusing on specific locations, specific
  ideas, and clarifying questions.
   Topics included commercial signage on Wilshire, , commercial architectural
  lighting on Wilshire, commercial signage on Robertson boulevard, ground
  floor design/use, architectural style, building design, wayfinding and
  placemaking.

  4) Activity and Feedback
   Staff asked for input and collected feedback.
  5) Adjournment
   The next meeting of the Strategic Planning Committee/Southeast Task
  Force is scheduled for December 9, 2019.

  Adjourn
  Date / Time  November 4, 2019 / 6:00pm
